name: slars
help:
usage: slars <command> [options]
       sa slars <command> [options]

Commands:
  init       [path]
  skills     [--json]
  stability  schema|verify ...
  build      [file] [-p <package>] [--out <file>]
  build-workspace [-p <package>] [sa-build-exe args]
  build-exe  [file] [-p <package>] [sa-build-exe args]
  build-wasm [file] [-p <package>] [sa-build-wasm args]
  build-js   [file] [-p <package>] [sa-build-js args]
  build-c    [file] [-p <package>] [sa-build-c args]
  sab build  [file] [-p <package>] [--out <file.sab>]
  sab workspace [-p <package>] [--sab-out <file.sab>] [sa-build-exe args]
  sab disasm <file.sab> [--out <file.sa>]
  slab build|workspace|disasm ...    Short alias
  check      [file] [-p <package>]
  test       [file] [-p <package>] [--test-backend auto|sab|sa] [sa-test args]

Options:
  -p, --package <name>                    Select a workspace member package
  --json                                  Emit JSON where supported
  -h, --help                              Show this help message
